subject: Supplier invoice intake: portal vs email + sample schema & escalation path
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@auroracloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier (AuroraCloud) — invoice submission options & sample

Hi Kimberly / Lauren,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week — excited to get AuroraCloud set up in Redwood's AP system. Finance asked me to confirm the preferred invoice intake method and to share a quick sample invoice so they can map fields on their side.

We can provide:
- Invoices via supplier portal (we currently use Coupa) as UBL/XML or CSV exports
- Email submission from ap@auroracloud.com with PDF/CSV attachments
- SFTP push of CSV files (we can schedule nightly batches)

Attached a one-page sample invoice (Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx). A couple of quick questions:
1) Does Redwood require strict PO matching for payment? If yes, what fields must match (PO number, line qty, unit price)?
2) Do you have a preferred line-item schema (tax per line, tax code, account string)?
3) Payment term (we currently pay Net30 by default) — is Net30 acceptable or should we expect Net45/Net60 for new suppliers?

Appreciate any mapping guidance so we can ensure our feeds match your ingestion rules.

Best,
Sophie Grant
AP Lead, AuroraCloud Inc.
[attachment: Sample_Invoice_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier (AuroraCloud) — invoice submission options & sample

Hi Sophie — thanks for the sample and options. High level guidance below so your team can pick the path with the least manual work: 

Preferred intake (order):
1) Redwood Supplier Portal (preferred) — enables automated PO matching and faster AP processing. We ingest UBL/CSV and support Coupa exports directly.
2) SFTP push (nightly) — acceptable for high-volume partners; must agree on filename pattern and schema.
3) Email ingestion to ap@redwood.com — allowed as fallback but it creates manual exceptions if PO metadata isn't machine-readable.

PO matching: yes, we require PO number for invoices against POs. Matching rules: PO number + line total (+/- tolerance for rounding) is sufficient for automated posting. If PO missing, invoice goes to exception queue and will require manual approval (slower).

Required invoice fields for automated ingestion:
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number (if applicable)
- line_description
- line_quantity
- unit_price
- line_total
- tax_amount (per invoice; support optionally per-line)
- currency
- remit_to_vendor_id or vendor_tax_id

Attached is a short PO_Matching_Guide.md with our filename examples and field names. Also, if you cannot support PO-level fields, include a CSV column called redwood_internal_note with the corresponding PO reference to help triage.

If portal is feasible, please send a contact to coordinate API or SFTP creds. If email only, send one test invoice to ap@redwood.com with subject line: NEW VENDOR TEST — AuroraCloud so we can validate mapping.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marcus on bank/onboarding fields to collect required vendor profile info.

Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: PO_Matching_Guide.md (text)]

Subject: Re: New supplier (AuroraCloud) — invoice submission options & sample

Thanks Kimberly — that's very helpful. A few follow-ups from our AP team:
- We can export UBL or CSV from Coupa. Our default CSV has columns: InvoiceID, InvoiceDate, POReference, SKU, Description, Qty, UnitPrice, Tax, Total, Currency, VendorRef. We can add a remit_to_vendor_id column if needed.
- For POs: we will populate POReference with your PO number if supplied on the PO. For non-PO invoices (e.g., one-off services), we'll leave that field blank and add a short note in the invoice comments.
- Payment terms: Net30 is standard for us. If Redwood requires Net45 for new suppliers, we should know prior to activation.

Sophie

Hi Sophie — quick procurement add-on and next steps from our side.

Proc rules & escalation path (short):
- PO requirement: PO number required for goods/services > $5,000. For amounts under $5k, AP may accept non-PO invoices but they still need a valid vendor profile.
- Portal: when suppliers use the portal, our system performs two-way matching (PO -> invoice) and autoposts when within tolerance. Portal setup reduces exceptions by ~80%.
- Email fallback: OK, but we will require the CSV to include the po_number column for automated capture. If PO missing, it drops to exception queue and will require procurement approval.

Vendor onboarding items we need to collect (we attach the onboarding form):
- Legal business name
- Tax ID / VAT registration
- Remittance address and remittance email
- Bank details (ACH/IBAN) + payee name
- Preferred payment term (Net30/45/60)
- Primary AP contact name + AP email

If portal is not feasible, please:
1) Send one test invoice to ap@redwood.com with subject: "NEW VENDOR TEST - AuroraCloud"
2) Copy onboarding@auroracloud.com and include the Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf completed (attached)
3) If test fails, escalate by opening a ticket at PROC-452 (link below) and cc procurement@redwood.com

We will aim to complete vendor activation within 5 business days once onboarding form + test invoice are received.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)]
